notes: Fixes code-proven utterance-loss paths behind sometimes-translates/sometimes-never: (1) direction-aware mic routing - own-speech directions (my-th/my-zh) keep headset-mic behaviour, other-person directions (th-my/zh-my) no longer force a headset mic and prefer the built-in phone mic closest to the other speaker; releasing the forced communication device cannot move media playback (TTS uses USAGE_MEDIA, A2DP to BT headphones unchanged). (2) A swallowed ERROR_CLIENT now logs error-client-suppressed and schedules the normal restart instead of leaving a dead session until the 20s watchdog. (3) Chunk/final atomicity - a chunk that fails or is dropped after the final was planned as TAIL rolls the tracker back so the final tail re-covers its words; spoken chunks are never re-spoken. (4) Loss visibility: results-blank, heard-empty-tail, activity-speak-muted/resumed, android-tts-init-pending log lines. v1.20 chunk translation + battery savings and v1.19 caches unchanged. No new permission, no new STT engine, no internal-audio capture, no voice commands, no model download. Residual intermittency from Google 429 / backend NO_MATCH in noise can remain - not claimed fixed; the phone verdict comes from normal use.
